name: x2611_15210_thm3_1
original:
For every finite abelian group $H$ whose exponent divides $n$ ,

(3.1)

 $A_{n}(H\oplus C_{n}^{5})\ \geq\ 12\,A_{n}(H\oplus C_{n})+8\,A_{n}(H\oplus C_{m}).$ 

Suppose moreover that $c>0$ and $\beta>1$ satisfy $A_{n}(C_{m}^{s})\geq c\beta^{s}$ for
all $s\geq 0$ . Let $\alpha$ be the unique positive root of

(3.2)

 $\alpha^{5}=12\alpha+8\beta.$ 

Then $\alpha>2$ , and for every $r\geq 1$ ,

(3.3)

 $\mathsf{s}(C_{n}^{r})\ \geq\ c\Bigl(\frac{2}{\alpha}\Bigr)^{4}\alpha^{r}+1.$
type: ∀ (m : ℕ), 3 ≤ m → Odd m → (∀ (H : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H], AddMonoid.exponent H ∣ 2 * m → 12 * Mathlib2.x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod (2 * m)) + 8 * Mathlib2.x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod m) ≤ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × (Fin 5 → ZMod (2 * m)))) ∧ ∀ (c β : ℝ), 0 < c → 1 < β → (∀ (s : ℕ), c * β ^ s ≤ ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (Fin s → ZMod m))) → ∃ α, 0 < α ∧ α ^ 5 = 12 * α + 8 * β ∧ (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x ^ 5 = 12 * x + 8 * β → x = α) ∧ 2 < α ∧ ∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ r + 1 ≤ ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_15210_s (2 * m) (Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)))

open scoped BigOperators

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux1 (β x y : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hxe : x ^ 5 = 12 * x + 8 * β) (hye : y ^ 5 = 12 * y + 8 * β) :
    x = y := by
  have hnot (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
      (hae : a ^ 5 = 12 * a + 8 * β) (hbe : b ^ 5 = 12 * b + 8 * β)
      (hab : a < b) : False := by
    have hp : a ^ 4 < b ^ 4 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hab ha.le (by norm_num)
    have he : a * b * (b ^ 4 - a ^ 4) = 8 * β * (a - b) := by
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t * b) hae,
        congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t * a) hbe]
    have hl : 0 < a * b * (b ^ 4 - a ^ 4) := by positivity
    have hr : 8 * β * (a - b) < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by positivity) (by linarith)
    linarith
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h | h | h
  · exact (hnot x y hx hy hxe hye h).elim
  · exact h
  · exact (hnot y x hy hx hye hxe h).elim

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux2 (β : ℝ) (hβ : 1 < β) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α ^ 5 = 12 * α + 8 * β ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ^ 5 = 12 * x + 8 * β → x = α) ∧ 2 < α := by
  let B : ℝ := 12 + 8 * β
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x ^ 5 - 12 * x - 8 * β
  have hB : 2 ≤ B := by dsimp [B]; linarith
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by linarith
  have hp : B ≤ B ^ 4 := le_self_pow₀ hB1 (by norm_num)
  have hfB : 0 ≤ f B := by
    have hBB : B * B ≤ B ^ 5 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by linarith : 0 ≤ B)]
    dsimp [f, B] at *
    nlinarith
  have hf2 : f 2 ≤ 0 := by dsimp [f]; norm_num; linarith
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 2 B) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨α, hα, he⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hB hcont ⟨hf2, hfB⟩
  have hαe : α ^ 5 = 12 * α + 8 * β := by dsimp [f] at he; linarith
  have hα0 : 0 < α := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hα.1
  refine ⟨α, hα0, hαe, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx hxe
    exact x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux1 β x α (by linarith) hx hα0 hxe hαe
  · have hn : α ≠ 2 := by intro h; subst α; norm_num at hαe; linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hα.1 (Ne.symm hn)

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux3 (b : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (c β α : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hα : 2 ≤ α)
    (hroot : α ^ 5 = 12 * α + 8 * β)
    (hbase : ∀ r s : ℕ, r < 5 → c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s ≤ b r s)
    (hstep : ∀ r s : ℕ, 12 * b (r + 1) s + 8 * b r (s + 1) ≤ b (r + 5) s) :
    ∀ r s : ℕ, c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ r * β ^ s ≤ b r s := by
  have ha0 : 0 < α := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ 2 / α := by positivity
  have hq1 : 2 / α ≤ 1 := (div_le_one ha0).mpr hα
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h r ih =>
    intro s
    by_cases hr : r < 5
    · have hpow : (2 / α) ^ 4 ≤ (2 / α) ^ r :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1 (by omega)
      calc
        c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ r * β ^ s ≤
            c * (2 / α) ^ r * α ^ r * β ^ s := by
              gcongr
        _ = c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s := by
          rw [div_pow]
          field_simp
        _ ≤ b r s := hbase r s hr
    · have h1 := ih (r - 4) (by omega) s
      have h2 := ih (r - 5) (by omega) (s + 1)
      have hs := hstep (r - 5) s
      have he1 : r - 5 + 1 = r - 4 := by omega
      have he2 : r - 5 + 5 = r := by omega
      rw [he1, he2] at hs
      have he : c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ r * β ^ s =
          12 * (c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ (r - 4) * β ^ s) +
          8 * (c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ (r - 5) * β ^ (s + 1)) := by
        have hr4 : r - 4 = r - 5 + 1 := by omega
        have hr5 : r = r - 5 + 5 := by omega
        have hp5 : α ^ r = α ^ (r - 5) * α ^ 5 := by
          rw [← pow_add]
          congr 1
        rw [hp5, hr4, pow_add, pow_one, hroot, pow_succ β]
        ring
      rw [he]
      linarith

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4 (L : ℕ) (G H : Type*)
    [AddCommMonoid G] [AddCommMonoid H] (e : G ≃+ H) :
    x2611_15210_A L G = x2611_15210_A L H := by
  have hprop (N : ℕ) :
      (∀ a : Fin N → G, ∃ I : Finset (Fin N), I.card = L ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0) ↔
      (∀ a : Fin N → H, ∃ I : Finset (Fin N), I.card = L ∧ ∑ i ∈ I, a i = 0) := by
    constructor
    · intro h a
      obtain ⟨I, hI, hz⟩ := h (fun i => e.symm (a i))
      refine ⟨I, hI, ?_⟩
      simpa only [map_sum, map_zero, e.apply_symm_apply] using congrArg e hz
    · intro h a
      obtain ⟨I, hI, hz⟩ := h (fun i => e (a i))
      refine ⟨I, hI, ?_⟩
      simpa only [map_sum, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] using congrArg e.symm hz
  unfold x2611_15210_A x2611_15210_s
  congr 2
  ext N
  exact hprop N

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux5 (n r t : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((Fin (r + t) → ZMod n) ≃+
      ((Fin r → ZMod n) × (Fin t → ZMod n))) := by
  exact ⟨((RingEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ => ZMod n) finSumFinEquiv.symm).trans
    (RingEquiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow (Fin r) (Fin t) (ZMod n))).toAddEquiv⟩

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux6 (L n m r s t : ℕ) :
    x2611_15210_A L (((Fin r → ZMod n) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) ×
      (Fin t → ZMod n)) =
      x2611_15210_A L ((Fin (r + t) → ZMod n) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) := by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux5 n r t
  let A := Fin r → ZMod n
  let B := Fin s → ZMod m
  let C := Fin t → ZMod n
  apply x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4
  exact (AddEquiv.prodAssoc : (A × B) × C ≃+ A × (B × C)).trans
    ((AddEquiv.prodCongr (AddEquiv.refl A) (AddEquiv.prodComm : B × C ≃+ C × B)).trans
      ((AddEquiv.prodAssoc : (A × C) × B ≃+ A × (C × B)).symm.trans
        (AddEquiv.prodCongr e.symm (AddEquiv.refl B))))

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux7 (L n m r s t : ℕ) :
    x2611_15210_A L (((Fin r → ZMod n) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) ×
      (Fin t → ZMod m)) =
      x2611_15210_A L ((Fin r → ZMod n) × (Fin (s + t) → ZMod m)) := by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux5 m s t
  apply x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4
  exact AddEquiv.prodAssoc.trans
    (AddEquiv.prodCongr (AddEquiv.refl _) e.symm)

lemma x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux8 (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (htransfer : ∀ (H : Type*) [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H],
      AddMonoid.exponent H ∣ 2 * m →
      12 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod (2 * m)) +
      8 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod m) ≤
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × (Fin 5 → ZMod (2 * m)))) (r s : ℕ) :
    12 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
      ((Fin (r + 1) → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) +
    8 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
      ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin (s + 1) → ZMod m)) ≤
    x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
      ((Fin (r + 5) → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) := by
  letI : NeZero m := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * m) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let G := (Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)
  let H := ULift.{u_1} G
  have hexp : AddMonoid.exponent H ∣ 2 * m := by
    apply AddMonoid.exponent_dvd_iff_forall_nsmul_eq_zero.mpr
    intro g
    apply (AddEquiv.ulift : H ≃+ G).injective
    change (2 * m) • g.down = 0
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext j
      change (2 * m) • g.down.1 j = 0
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
    · funext j
      change (2 * m) • g.down.2 j = 0
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
  have h := htransfer H hexp
  have he (K : Type) [AddCommMonoid K] :
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × K) = x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (G × K) :=
    x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4 _ _ _
      (AddEquiv.prodCongr AddEquiv.ulift (AddEquiv.refl K))
  simp only [he] at h
  have he1 : x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (G × ZMod (2 * m)) =
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (G × (Fin 1 → ZMod (2 * m))) :=
    x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4 _ _ _
      (AddEquiv.prodCongr (AddEquiv.refl G) (AddEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) (ZMod (2 * m))).symm)
  have he2 : x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (G × ZMod m) =
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (G × (Fin 1 → ZMod m)) :=
    x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4 _ _ _
      (AddEquiv.prodCongr (AddEquiv.refl G) (AddEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) (ZMod m)).symm)
  rw [he1, he2] at h
  change 12 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) ×
      (Fin s → ZMod m)) × (Fin 1 → ZMod (2 * m))) +
    8 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) ×
      (Fin s → ZMod m)) × (Fin 1 → ZMod m)) ≤
    x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) ×
      (Fin s → ZMod m)) × (Fin 5 → ZMod (2 * m))) at h
  simpa only [x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux6, x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux7] using h

theorem x2611_15210_thm3_1 (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) (hodd : Odd m) :
    (∀ (H : Type*) [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H], AddMonoid.exponent H ∣ 2 * m →
      12 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod (2 * m)) +
      8 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod m) ≤
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × (Fin 5 → ZMod (2 * m)))) ∧
    ∀ c β : ℝ, 0 < c → 1 < β →
      (∀ s : ℕ, c * β ^ s ≤ (x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (Fin s → ZMod m) : ℝ)) →
      ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α ^ 5 = 12 * α + 8 * β ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x ^ 5 = 12 * x + 8 * β → x = α) ∧ 2 < α ∧
        ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → c * (2 / α) ^ 4 * α ^ r + 1 ≤
          (x2611_15210_s (2 * m) (Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) : ℝ) := by
  have transfer : ∀ (H : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup H] [Fintype H],
      AddMonoid.exponent H ∣ 2 * m →
      12 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod (2 * m)) +
      8 * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × ZMod m) ≤
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (H × (Fin 5 → ZMod (2 * m))) := by
    sorry
  have base : ∀ r s : ℕ,
      2 ^ r * x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (Fin s → ZMod m) ≤
      x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
        ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) := by

    intro r s
    letI : NeZero m := ⟨by omega⟩
    letI : NeZero (2 * m) := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hz : ∀ g : Fin s → ZMod m, (2 * m) • g = 0 := by
      intro g
      ext j
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
    have hb := x2611_15210_lem2_2_aux7 (2 * m) (by omega) (Fin s → ZMod m) hz r
    have he := x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux4 (2 * m) _ _
      (AddEquiv.prodComm : ((Fin s → ZMod m) × (Fin r → ZMod (2 * m))) ≃+
        ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)))
    rwa [he] at hb
  refine ⟨transfer, ?_⟩
  intro c β hc hβ hbound
  obtain ⟨α, hα0, hroot, huniq, hα2⟩ := x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux2 β hβ
  refine ⟨α, hα0, hroot, huniq, hα2, ?_⟩
  have hbase : ∀ r s : ℕ, r < 5 → c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s ≤
      (x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
        ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) : ℝ) := by
    intro r s _
    have hb : (2 : ℝ) ^ r *
        (x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (Fin s → ZMod m) : ℝ) ≤
        (x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
          ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast base r s
    calc
      c * 2 ^ r * β ^ s = 2 ^ r * (c * β ^ s) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ r * (x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (Fin s → ZMod m) : ℝ) := by
        gcongr
        exact hbound s
      _ ≤ _ := hb
  have hstep : ∀ r s : ℕ,
      12 * (x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
        ((Fin (r + 1) → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) : ℝ) +
      8 * (x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
        ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin (s + 1) → ZMod m)) : ℝ) ≤
      (x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
        ((Fin (r + 5) → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) : ℝ) := by
    intro r s
    exact_mod_cast x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux8 m (by omega) transfer r s
  have hgrowth := x2611_15210_thm3_1_aux3
    (fun r s => (x2611_15210_A (2 * m)
      ((Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) × (Fin s → ZMod m)) : ℝ))
    c β α hc.le (by linarith) hα2.le hroot hbase hstep
  intro r hr
  have hg := hgrowth r 0
  have he : x2611_15210_A (2 * m)

  have hpos : 0 < (x2611_15210_A (2 * m) (Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)) : ℝ) :=

    unfold x2611_15210_A at *
